value.title: Saint-Jacques-Saint-Christophe de la Villette
value.extract: Saint-Jacques-Saint-Christophe de la Villette is a Roman-Catholic Church located at 6, place de Bitche, between the Square Serge-Reggiani and the Place de Joinville in the 19th arrondissement of Paris. It was built between 1841 et 1844 in the Neoclassical style.
